method_zh: 58幅均獨立盤點書面與有字欄，選讀題記、條首、夾注及模糊字，比對初錄並以原圖裁定。覆核為逐幅選讀，未製作獨立全文二稿。部分第001–020幅條首曾在格式整合時讀到。保留疑讀與原字。
method_en: All 58 images received a separate layout inventory and selected readings, focusing on inscriptions, headings, annotations and difficult characters. Proposed changes were checked against the scan. This is selective rereading of every image, rather than a second full transcription. Some headings in images 001–020 were seen during format inspection.
